blocks.zh: 附錄4：風險管理確效屬性
blocks.en: Appendix 4: Risk-Based Validation Attributes

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握單次使用系統 (SUS) 15項風險管理確效屬性的測試目的、標準方法及驗收準則，包括生物相容性、機械性能、氣體穿透、藥典理化檢測與動物來源控制
blocks.en: Master the test purpose, standard methods and acceptance criteria for the 15 risk-based validation attributes of single-use systems (SUS), including biocompatibility, mechanical properties, gas transmission, compendial physicochemical testing and animal origin control

blocks.zh: 理解可萃取物/可浸出物 (E&L) 研究的設計空間概念，熟悉極性/非極性溶劑、pH範圍、溫度條件的組合測試策略，以及如何運用供應商文件進行風險評估
blocks.en: Understand the design space concept for extractables/leachables (E&L) studies, the combined test strategy of polar/non-polar solvents, pH range and temperature conditions, and how to use supplier documentation for risk assessment

blocks.zh: 辨別 TOC、pH、導電度作為非專一性一致性測試指標的定位——了解它們在確效期間建立基準值的意義，而非作為放行標準
blocks.en: Distinguish the role of TOC, pH and conductivity as non-specific consistency tests: understand that their value lies in establishing baseline values during validation, not in serving as release criteria

blocks.zh: 理解無菌性 (SAL) 驗證、容器密封完整性 (CCI) 測試方法的技術要求，以及微粒測試、蛋白質吸附研究和嵌入式儀器校正的實務考量
blocks.en: Understand the technical requirements for sterility assurance level (SAL) validation and container closure integrity (CCI) testing, as well as practical considerations for particulate testing, protein adsorption studies and calibration of embedded instrumentation

blocks.zh: 建立「屬性 = 材料風險 + 應用條件 + 法規要求」的整合思維，能在供應商資格評估與使用者需求規格 (URS) 撰寫中靈活應用
blocks.en: Build an integrated mindset of "attribute = material risk + application conditions + regulatory requirements" that can be applied flexibly in supplier qualification and in writing the user requirements specification (URS)

blocks.zh: 8.1 Attribute 1: Biocompatibility Testing（生物相容性測試）
blocks.en: 8.1 Attribute 1: Biocompatibility Testing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：生物相容性的法規框架
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Regulatory Framework for Biocompatibility

blocks.zh: 生物相容性 (Biocompatibility) 測試是確認聚合物材料不會對生物體造成有害反應的核心要求。對於有產品接觸的單次使用系統組件，這是最基礎的安全門檻。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility testing confirms that a polymer material will not cause adverse reactions in living organisms. For SUS components with product contact, it is the most fundamental safety threshold.

blocks.zh: 主要測試路徑有兩條：
blocks.en: There are two main testing routes:

blocks.zh: USP <87> / <88>：美國藥典路徑，體外 (in vitro) + 體內 (in vivo) 組合
blocks.en: USP <87> / <88>: the US Pharmacopeia route, combining in vitro and in vivo testing

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1：國際標準路徑，風險評估導向，需要科學論證等效性
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1: the international standard route, which is risk-assessment driven and requires scientific justification of equivalence

blocks.zh: 重要：供應商必須提供實際反應性評分（如 Grade 0, 1, 2），而非僅僅寫「Pass」——監管機構要求可審查的原始數據。
blocks.en: Important: the supplier must provide the actual reactivity scores (e.g., Grade 0, 1, 2) and not merely write "Pass"; regulators expect raw data that can be reviewed.

blocks.zh: 測試方法對照 Test Methods
blocks.en: Test Methods

blocks.zh:
USP <87> 體外細胞毒性：
  溶出試驗 (Elution test)：
    萃取媒介 → 小鼠纖維母細胞單層
    觀察時間：48小時

  瓊脂擴散試驗 (Agar diffusion)：
    材料直接置於瓊脂表面
    觀察時間：24小時

USP <88> 體內生物反應性：
  Class VI 塑膠（最嚴格等級）
  萃取溫度：70°C
  包括全身注射、皮內注射、植入測試

判定標準：
  Grade 0 = 無反應（理想結果）
  Grade <2 = 輕度敏感（可接受上限）
blocks.en:
USP <87> in vitro cytotoxicity:
  Elution test:
    Extraction medium → mouse fibroblast monolayer
    Observation time: 48 hours

  Agar diffusion test:
    Material placed directly on the agar surface
    Observation time: 24 hours

USP <88> in vivo biological reactivity:
  Class VI plastics (most stringent class)
  Extraction temperature: 70°C
  Includes systemic injection, intracutaneous injection and implantation tests

Acceptance criteria:
  Grade 0 = no reaction (ideal result)
  Grade <2 = mild sensitization (acceptable upper limit)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 生物相容性測試就像食品添加物的毒性試驗——在確認一種新的包裝材料可以接觸食品之前，必須證明它不會把有害物質溶出到食物中。Class VI 是塑膠的最高安全等級，就像食品接觸材料的「食品級」認證，代表可以在最嚴苛條件下安全接觸生物體。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility testing is like toxicity testing for food additives: before a new packaging material can be approved for food contact, you must show that it will not leach harmful substances into the food. Class VI is the highest safety class for plastics, much like a "food grade" certification for food contact materials, and means the material can safely contact living organisms under the harshest conditions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 的方法體系與 USP <87>/<88> 不完全相同，供應商若選擇 ISO 路徑，必須提供書面的科學論證說明兩者等效。這在法規審查中常被忽略，容易導致 Warning Letter 或 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: The ISO 10993-1 methodology is not identical to USP <87>/<88>. If a supplier chooses the ISO route, it must provide a written scientific justification that the two are equivalent. This is often overlooked in regulatory reviews and can easily lead to a Warning Letter or a Form 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Application
blocks.en: Application

blocks.zh: 在評估新供應商的生物相容性文件時，要求提供以下資訊：
blocks.en: When evaluating a new supplier's biocompatibility documentation, request the following:

blocks.zh: GLP 認可實驗室的完整測試報告（非摘要）
blocks.en: Complete test reports (not summaries) from a GLP-accredited laboratory

blocks.zh: 每項測試的實際評分（Grade 數字）
blocks.en: The actual score for each test (Grade number)

blocks.zh: 測試樣品是否與供貨狀態一致（例如是否已伽瑪輻射）
blocks.en: Whether the test samples match the as-supplied state (e.g., whether they were gamma irradiated)

blocks.zh: 若使用 ISO 10993，需要等效性論證文件
blocks.en: If ISO 10993 is used, a documented equivalence justification

blocks.zh: 8.2 Attribute 2: Mechanical Properties（機械性能）
blocks.en: 8.2 Attribute 2: Mechanical Properties

blocks.zh: 核心概念：機械性能測試的重要性
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why Mechanical Property Testing Matters

blocks.zh: 機械性能 (Mechanical Properties) 測試確保單次使用系統在整個生命週期中（儲存、運輸、使用中）維持物理完整性。對於生物製藥製程，這意味著袋子不會在攪拌或運輸中破損，管件不會在壓力下爆裂，連接器在反覆插拔後仍能保持密封。
blocks.en: Mechanical properties testing ensures that a single-use system maintains its physical integrity throughout its life cycle (storage, transport and use). For a biopharmaceutical process, this means that bags do not rupture during mixing or shipping, tubing does not burst under pressure, and connectors remain sealed after repeated connection and disconnection.

blocks.zh: 機械性能關鍵測試項目通常包括：抗拉強度、密封強度、衝擊/穿刺阻力、彎曲疲勞性、膜厚度均勻性。
blocks.en: Key mechanical tests typically include: tensile strength, seal strength, impact/puncture resistance, flex-crack resistance and film thickness uniformity.

blocks.zh: 想像採購一批輸液袋——你不只需要確認袋子現在沒有漏，還需要知道它在零下 20°C 儲存後是否變脆、在輸液泵驅動下重複彎折 1000 次後是否裂開。機械性能測試就是在模擬這些「最壞使用情境」，確保 SUS 組件在任何實際操作條件下都不會成為污染風險的來源。
blocks.en: Imagine buying a batch of infusion bags: you need to confirm not only that the bags do not leak today, but also whether they become brittle after storage at -20°C, and whether they crack after being flexed 1,000 times by an infusion pump. Mechanical property testing simulates these "worst-case use scenarios" so that SUS components do not become a source of contamination under any realistic operating condition.

blocks.zh: ASTM F2097 是彈性包裝的設計與評估指南，而 BPSA 的測試矩陣指南則針對生物製程 SUS 組件，提供更具體的測試項目清單與業界最佳實踐。供應商應按照各自產品類型（袋子、管件、連接器等）提供對應的機械測試數據包。
blocks.en: ASTM F2097 is a guide for the design and evaluation of flexible packaging, while the BPSA test matrix guide targets bioprocess SUS components and gives a more specific list of tests and industry best practice. Suppliers should provide the mechanical test data package that corresponds to each product type (bags, tubing, connectors, etc.).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠，當 SUS 袋子在製程中出現微小裂縫時，你如何在事後追蹤是材料缺陷還是操作問題？機械性能基準數據如何幫助根本原因分析？
blocks.en: In your facility, when a SUS bag develops a small crack during processing, how would you trace afterwards whether it was a material defect or an operational problem? How would baseline mechanical property data help the root cause analysis?

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的機械測試數據通常是在「標準」條件下獲得的。如果你的製程條件（溫度、壓力、接觸時間）超出了供應商的測試範圍，應如何處理？
blocks.en: Mechanical test data from suppliers are usually generated under "standard" conditions. If your process conditions (temperature, pressure, contact time) fall outside the supplier's tested range, how should you handle it?

blocks.zh: 8.3 Attribute 3: Gas Transmission Properties（氣體穿透性質）
blocks.en: 8.3 Attribute 3: Gas Transmission Properties

blocks.zh: 核心概念：氣體穿透性與產品穩定性
blocks.en: Key Concept: Gas Transmission and Product Stability

blocks.zh: 氣體穿透性 (Gas Transmission) 是評估塑膠膜材料能否有效阻隔氧氣和水蒸氣的關鍵指標。對生物製藥製程而言：
blocks.en: Gas transmission is a key indicator of whether a plastic film can effectively block oxygen and water vapor. For biopharmaceutical processes:

blocks.zh: 氧氣穿透率 (OTR, Oxygen Transmission Rate)：直接關係到對氧氣敏感的生物製品（如蛋白質、疫苗）的穩定性
blocks.en: Oxygen Transmission Rate (OTR): directly affects the stability of oxygen-sensitive biological products (e.g., proteins, vaccines)

blocks.zh: 水蒸氣穿透率 (WVTR, Water Vapor Transmission Rate)：影響產品長期儲存中的濃度變化與容器完整性
blocks.en: Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR): affects concentration changes and container integrity during long-term storage

blocks.zh: 測試條件要求 Test Condition Requirements
blocks.en: Test Condition Requirements

blocks.zh:
報告氣體穿透數據時，必須明確聲明：
  - 膜厚度（µm 或 mil）
  - 測試溫度（°C）
  - 氧氣分壓（膜兩側各別）
  - 上游側的相對濕度（%RH）

若偏離 ASTM 標準方法：
  - 必須明確說明偏差之處
  - 不得僅報告數值而省略條件
blocks.en:
When reporting gas transmission data, the following must be stated explicitly:
  - Film thickness (µm or mil)
  - Test temperature (°C)
  - Oxygen partial pressure (on each side of the film)
  - Relative humidity on the upstream side (%RH)

If the ASTM standard method is deviated from:
  - The deviations must be clearly described
  - Values must not be reported without their conditions

blocks.zh: 氣體穿透測試就像測試保鮮袋的保鮮能力——同樣的薄膜，在 4°C 的冰箱裡和在 40°C 的熱帶地區，讓氧氣穿透的速率完全不同。所以法規要求必須報告測試條件，否則數字沒有意義。多層膜結構（如 EVA/EVOH/PE）就像保溫杯的多層設計，每一層各自扮演不同的阻隔角色。
blocks.en: Gas transmission testing is like testing how well a food storage bag keeps food fresh: the same film lets oxygen through at very different rates in a 4°C refrigerator and in a 40°C tropical climate. That is why the test conditions must be reported; without them the number is meaningless. A multilayer film structure (e.g., EVA/EVOH/PE) is like the multiple layers of a thermos flask, where each layer plays a different barrier role.

blocks.zh: 在長期儲存研究（如 24 個月穩定性）中，如果使用 SUS 袋子儲存對氧化敏感的 mAb 製品，必須確認袋子的 OTR 在整個儲存溫度範圍內都符合要求。若供應商的氣體穿透數據是在 23°C/0%RH 條件下測試，而你的儲存條件是 2-8°C，需要確認數據是否適用或要求補充測試。
blocks.en: In long-term storage studies (e.g., 24-month stability), if a SUS bag is used to store an oxidation-sensitive mAb product, you must confirm that the bag OTR meets requirements across the whole storage temperature range. If the supplier gas transmission data were generated at 23°C/0%RH and your storage condition is 2-8°C, you need to confirm that the data are applicable or request supplementary testing.

blocks.zh: 8.4 Attribute 4: Compendial Physicochemical Testing（藥典理化測試）
blocks.en: 8.4 Attribute 4: Compendial Physicochemical Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：藥典理化測試的目的
blocks.en: Key Concept: Purpose of Compendial Physicochemical Testing

blocks.zh: 藥典理化測試 (Compendial Physicochemical Testing) 是針對特定聚合物類型的標準化特性鑑定，確認材料符合藥典規格。
blocks.en: Compendial physicochemical testing is a standardized characterization specific to each polymer type, confirming that the material meets pharmacopeial specifications.

blocks.zh: USP <661> 和 EP 3.1.x 系列是兩大主要框架，兩者的測試項目有部分重疊，但各自有獨特要求。
blocks.en: USP <661> and the EP 3.1.x series are the two main frameworks; their test items partly overlap, but each has unique requirements.

blocks.zh: IR 光譜：確認聚合物身份（polymer identity），防止材料代換
blocks.en: IR spectroscopy: confirms polymer identity and prevents material substitution

blocks.zh: DSC（差示掃描量熱法）：確認熔點範圍，確保材料一致性
blocks.en: DSC (differential scanning calorimetry): confirms the melting point range and ensures material consistency

blocks.zh: 重金屬、不揮發殘留物：確認無有害雜質殘留
blocks.en: Heavy metals and non-volatile residue: confirm the absence of harmful impurities

blocks.zh: EP 的測試矩陣（Table 8.1）依聚合物類型而異。例如，含添加劑的 PP（EP 3.1.6）需要測試可萃取鉻和釩，而不含添加劑的 PE（EP 3.1.4）則不需要——因為這些金屬通常來自催化劑殘留，而後者製程使用不同催化劑體系。
blocks.en: The EP test matrix (Table 8.1) varies by polymer type. For example, PP with additives (EP 3.1.6) requires testing for extractable chromium and vanadium, whereas PE without additives (EP 3.1.4) does not, because these metals usually come from catalyst residues and the latter is made with a different catalyst system.

blocks.zh: 實務提示：供應商提供的 CoA（分析證書）必須對應到你所購買組件的聚合物類型，不能使用不同材質的測試報告。
blocks.en: Practical tip: the supplier CoA (certificate of analysis) must correspond to the polymer type of the component you are buying; a test report for a different material cannot be used.

blocks.zh: 藥典理化測試就像汽車出廠的品質檢驗——不同車款（PP、PE、PETG）有不同的檢驗清單。不能用 Toyota Camry 的出廠檢驗報告來代替 Toyota RAV4 的報告，即使兩者都是 Toyota。同樣地，EP 3.1.5（含添加劑 PE）的測試報告不能替代 EP 3.1.6（含添加劑 PP）的要求。
blocks.en: Compendial physicochemical testing is like the factory quality inspection of a car: different models (PP, PE, PETG) have different inspection checklists. You cannot use the factory inspection report of a Toyota Camry in place of the report for a Toyota RAV4, even though both are Toyotas. Likewise, a test report for EP 3.1.5 (PE with additives) cannot replace the requirements of EP 3.1.6 (PP with additives).

blocks.zh: 你的供應商提供了一份 USP <661> 測試報告，但你的採購規格要求符合 EP 3.1.x。你需要採取哪些步驟來確認是否需要補充測試？
blocks.en: Your supplier provides a USP <661> test report, but your purchasing specification requires compliance with EP 3.1.x. What steps should you take to confirm whether supplementary testing is needed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「不揮發殘留物」(Non-volatile residue) 這個指標對於注射劑接觸材料特別重要？如果超標代表什麼意義？
blocks.en: Why is the "non-volatile residue" indicator particularly important for materials in contact with injectable products? What does it mean if the limit is exceeded?

blocks.zh: 8.5 Attribute 5: Animal Origin Control（動物來源管控）
blocks.en: 8.5 Attribute 5: Animal Origin Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TSE/BSE 風險控制框架
blocks.en: Key Concept: The TSE/BSE Risk Control Framework

blocks.zh: 動物來源管控 (Animal Origin Control) 的核心擔憂是傳遞性海綿狀腦病 (TSE, Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathy)，特別是牛海綿狀腦病 (BSE, Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy，俗稱「狂牛病」)。
blocks.en: The core concern of animal origin control is transmissible spongiform encephalopathy (TSE), in particular bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, commonly known as "mad cow disease").

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：
blocks.en: Key terms:

blocks.zh: TSE：包括 BSE（牛）、scrapie（羊）等朊蛋白病
blocks.en: TSE: prion diseases including BSE (cattle) and scrapie (sheep)

blocks.zh: PrPsc（朊蛋白瘙癢病型）：病原性朊蛋白，耐高溫、耐輻射，極難滅活
blocks.en: PrPsc (scrapie-type prion protein): the pathogenic prion protein, resistant to heat and radiation and extremely difficult to inactivate

blocks.zh: EDQM CEP（歐洲藥品品質理事會適用性證書）：供應商需提供的合規文件
blocks.en: EDQM CEP (European Directorate for the Quality of Medicines Certificate of Suitability): the compliance document the supplier needs to provide

blocks.zh: 動物來源管控就像食物過敏原管理——問題不只在產品本身，而在於整個製造環境。就算你的 SUS 袋子本身不含牛源成分，但如果工廠用含牛脂的潤滑劑來維護機器，而那台機器又接觸了你的袋子，就有交叉污染風險。所以詢問範圍要涵蓋：原料、製程輔助物、設備潤滑劑、清潔劑，以及培養基充填用的基材。
blocks.en: Animal origin control is like food allergen management: the issue is not only the product itself but the whole manufacturing environment. Even if your SUS bag contains no bovine-derived ingredients, there is a cross-contamination risk if the plant uses a tallow-containing lubricant to maintain a machine that then contacts your bag. The scope of inquiry therefore needs to cover raw materials, processing aids, equipment lubricants, cleaning agents, and the substrates used for media fill.

blocks.zh: TSE 朊蛋白的獨特危險性在於它的極端穩定性——134°C 高壓蒸氣滅菌 18 分鐘都無法完全消除。這也是為什麼法規要求的是「源頭控制」（不使用含 TSE 風險的材料）而非「終末滅菌消除」。CEP 文件是唯一被法規接受的書面保證形式。
blocks.en: The unique danger of TSE prions is their extreme stability: even autoclaving at 134°C for 18 minutes does not fully eliminate them. This is why regulations require "source control" (not using materials with TSE risk) rather than "elimination by terminal sterilization". A CEP document is the only written form of assurance accepted by regulators.

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核時，動物來源聲明需涵蓋以下四個層次：
blocks.en: During supplier audits, the animal origin statement needs to cover the following four levels:

blocks.zh: 組件本身的原材料（聚合物、添加劑）
blocks.en: Raw materials of the component itself (polymers, additives)

blocks.zh: 製造過程中使用的加工助劑（潤滑劑、脫模劑）
blocks.en: Processing aids used during manufacturing (lubricants, mold release agents)

blocks.zh: 設備清潔劑（含有動物脂肪酸衍生物的清潔劑）
blocks.en: Equipment cleaning agents (those containing animal fatty acid derivatives)

blocks.zh: 用於培養基模擬灌裝 (Media Fill) 的確效物質
blocks.en: Materials used for media fill (APS) validation

blocks.zh: 你的 SUS 袋子供應商來自美國，而美國被 EU 視為 BSE 風險「Unlikely but not excluded」國家。你需要要求供應商提供什麼額外文件？
blocks.en: Your SUS bag supplier is based in the United States, which the EU considers a country with a BSE risk of "Unlikely but not excluded". What additional documentation should you ask the supplier to provide?

blocks.zh: 供應商聲稱其潤滑劑不含動物成分，但沒有 CEP 文件，只有一份自我聲明書。這在 EU 法規稽核中是否足夠？
blocks.en: A supplier claims that its lubricant contains no animal-derived components but has no CEP document, only a self-declaration. Is this sufficient in an EU regulatory audit?

blocks.zh: 8.6 Attribute 6: Total Organic Carbon Analysis（總有機碳分析）
blocks.en: 8.6 Attribute 6: Total Organic Carbon Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TOC 的定位——非專一性一致性指標
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Role of TOC as a Non-Specific Consistency Indicator

blocks.zh: 總有機碳 (TOC, Total Organic Carbon) 測量水溶液中所有有機碳的總量，是一個非專一性 (non-specific) 的指標——它告訴你「有多少有機物溶出了」，但不告訴你「是什麼有機物」。
blocks.en: Total organic carbon (TOC) measures the total amount of organic carbon in an aqueous solution. It is a non-specific indicator: it tells you "how much organic material has leached out" but not "what the organic material is".

blocks.zh: TOC 在 SUS 確效中的三個作用：
blocks.en: Three roles of TOC in SUS validation:

blocks.zh: 確效基準建立：確效階段的首要目的，建立批次間的可比較基準值
blocks.en: Establishing a validation baseline: the primary purpose at the validation stage is to establish a baseline value for comparison between batches

blocks.zh: 製程一致性監控：後續進廠檢測時，異常偏高的 TOC 可觸發調查
blocks.en: Monitoring process consistency: in later incoming testing, an abnormally high TOC can trigger an investigation

blocks.zh: 清洗效果驗證：如適用，可用於驗證組件清洗效果
blocks.en: Verifying cleaning effectiveness: where applicable, it can be used to verify the cleaning of components

blocks.zh: 測試規格 Test Specifications
blocks.en: Test Specifications

blocks.zh:
標準方法：USP <643>
報告單位：mg/L（或 ppm）

測試樣品代表性要求：
  供貨狀態 = 伽瑪輻射 → 測試樣品必須伽瑪輻射
  供貨狀態 = 未輻射 → 測試樣品可不輻射

注意：確效階段通常無驗收標準，
數值僅作為後續監測的基準參考值
blocks.en:
Standard method: USP <643>
Reporting unit: mg/L (or ppm)

Sample representativeness requirements:
  As-supplied state = gamma irradiated → test samples must be gamma irradiated
  As-supplied state = non-irradiated → test samples need not be irradiated

Note: there is usually no acceptance criterion at the validation stage;
the values serve only as baseline reference values for later monitoring

blocks.zh: TOC 就像廚房排水管水質的「濁度計」——它只能告訴你水有多髒（總有機物量），但不能告訴你是油脂、蔬菜殘渣還是清潔劑。雖然資訊不夠精確，但長期監控的趨勢分析非常有用——如果某批袋子的 TOC 突然是平常的三倍，就算不知道是什麼東西，也已經是一個需要調查的信號。
blocks.en: TOC is like a "turbidity meter" for kitchen drain water: it only tells you how dirty the water is (total organic content), not whether it is grease, vegetable scraps or detergent. Although the information is not precise, long-term trend analysis is very useful: if the TOC of a batch of bags is suddenly three times the usual level, even without knowing what the substance is, it is already a signal that needs investigation.

blocks.zh: 伽瑪輻射會改變聚合物的化學結構，可能增加可溶出有機物的種類和數量。因此，測試樣品的處理狀態必須與實際供貨狀態完全一致——這個原則貫穿所有 15 項屬性的測試要求。
blocks.en: Gamma irradiation changes the chemical structure of polymers and may increase the types and amounts of leachable organic substances. The sample treatment state must therefore be exactly the same as the actual as-supplied state; this principle runs through the test requirements of all 15 attributes.

blocks.zh: 8.7 Attribute 7: pH and Conductivity（pH 值與導電度）
blocks.en: 8.7 Attribute 7: pH and Conductivity

blocks.zh: 核心概念：pH 與導電度作為一致性指標
blocks.en: Key Concept: pH and Conductivity as Consistency Indicators

blocks.zh: pH 值和導電度 (Conductivity) 同屬非專一性測試，與 TOC 類似，其主要功能是製程一致性監控，而非精確識別溶出物種類。
blocks.en: pH and conductivity are both non-specific tests. Like TOC, their main function is process consistency monitoring, not the precise identification of the leached species.

blocks.zh: 偏低的 pH 可能代表有機酸性物質溶出；偏高則可能代表鹼性添加劑釋放。導電度偏高通常反映離子性物質溶出（如抗氧化劑、穩定劑的降解產物）。
blocks.en: A low pH may indicate leaching of organic acidic substances, while a high pH may indicate release of basic additives. High conductivity usually reflects leaching of ionic substances (e.g., degradation products of antioxidants and stabilizers).

blocks.zh: 一般驗收指標 General Acceptance Ranges
blocks.en: General Acceptance Ranges

blocks.zh:
pH（一般應用）：
  測試液：無 CO₂ 水（Carbon dioxide free water）
  可接受範圍：5.0 ≤ pH ≤ 8.0

導電度（一般應用）：
  測試液：藥典級 WFI
  可接受上限：≤ 2 × WFI 基準導電度

注意：
  - 特殊應用（如強酸/鹼緩衝液接觸）可有不同範圍
  - 確效階段建立基準值；後續進廠檢驗可用作篩選標準
blocks.en:
pH (general applications):
  Test solution: carbon dioxide free water
  Acceptable range: 5.0 ≤ pH ≤ 8.0

Conductivity (general applications):
  Test solution: pharmacopeial-grade WFI
  Acceptable upper limit: ≤ 2 × WFI baseline conductivity

Note:
  - Special applications (e.g., contact with strong acid/base buffers) may have different ranges
  - Baseline values are established at the validation stage; later incoming inspection can use them as screening criteria

blocks.zh: pH 和導電度就像血液檢查的「常規生化」——pH 相當於血液酸鹼度，導電度相當於電解質濃度。兩者的單次數值不足以診斷特定疾病，但長期追蹤趨勢時，如果某批次組件的沖洗水 pH 突然從正常的 6.5 降到 4.0，就意味著需要深入調查是哪種酸性物質大量溶出。
blocks.en: pH and conductivity are like the "routine biochemistry panel" in a blood test: pH corresponds to blood acidity and conductivity to electrolyte concentration. A single value of either is not enough to diagnose a specific disease, but when trends are tracked over time, if the rinse water pH of a batch of components suddenly drops from the normal 6.5 to 4.0, it means you need to investigate in depth which acidic substance is leaching in large amounts.

blocks.zh: 在建立 SUS 供應商的進廠檢驗 (Incoming Quality Control) 規格時，可利用確效期間的 pH 和導電度數據建立管制界限。例如，若確效期間 10 個批次的沖洗水 pH 均在 6.2–6.8 範圍內，可設定進廠上限為 pH 7.0，超出時觸發調查——這比單純依賴藥典的 5-8 範圍更具製程敏感性。
blocks.en: When setting incoming quality control specifications for a SUS supplier, the pH and conductivity data from the validation period can be used to set control limits. For example, if the rinse water pH of 10 batches during validation was all within 6.2–6.8, an incoming upper limit of pH 7.0 can be set, with an investigation triggered when it is exceeded. This is more sensitive to the process than relying solely on the pharmacopeial range of 5-8.

blocks.zh: 8.8 Attribute 8: Extractables and Leachables（可萃取物與可浸出物）
blocks.en: 8.8 Attribute 8: Extractables and Leachables

blocks.zh: 核心概念：E&L 的根本區別
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Fundamental Difference in E&L

blocks.zh: 可萃取物 (Extractables) vs 可浸出物 (Leachables) 是 SUS 風險評估中最重要的概念對，也最常被混淆：
blocks.en: Extractables vs leachables is the most important and most frequently confused pair of concepts in SUS risk assessment:

blocks.zh: Extractables：在「誇張條件」下（極性/非極性溶劑、極端 pH、高溫）強制從材料中萃取出的所有化合物——代表最大可能釋放量，用於定義「設計空間」的邊界
blocks.en: Extractables: all compounds forcibly extracted from the material under "exaggerated conditions" (polar/non-polar solvents, extreme pH, high temperature). They represent the maximum possible release and are used to define the boundaries of the "design space"

blocks.zh: Leachables：在「實際使用條件」下從材料中浸出到產品中的化合物——代表真實風險，是患者安全評估的直接依據
blocks.en: Leachables: compounds that migrate from the material into the product under "actual use conditions". They represent the real risk and are the direct basis for patient safety assessment

blocks.zh: 關係：Extractables ⊇ Leachables（可萃取物涵蓋所有潛在可浸出物，但實際浸出量通常遠低於萃取量）
blocks.en: Relationship: Extractables ⊇ Leachables (extractables cover all potential leachables, but actual leached amounts are usually far lower than extracted amounts)

blocks.zh: E&L 分析方法三件套
blocks.en: The Three Core E&L Analytical Methods

blocks.zh:
最低要求的分析方法組合：
  1. GC-MS（氣相層析/質譜）
     → 揮發性和半揮發性有機化合物

  2. HPLC-UV/Vis 或 HPLC-MS
     → 非揮發性有機化合物
     （如抗氧化劑、UV 吸收劑）

  3. ICP-MS（感應耦合電漿/質譜）
     → 微量金屬元素

數據單位：
  袋子類組件：ppm 或 mg/in²
  管件類組件：mg/in length
  過濾器類：mg/unit
blocks.en:
Minimum required combination of analytical methods:
  1. GC-MS (gas chromatography/mass spectrometry)
     → volatile and semi-volatile organic compounds

  2. HPLC-UV/Vis or HPLC-MS
     → non-volatile organic compounds
     (e.g., antioxidants, UV absorbers)

  3. ICP-MS (inductively coupled plasma/mass spectrometry)
     → trace metal elements

Data units:
  Bag-type components: ppm or mg/in²
  Tubing-type components: mg/in length
  Filter-type components: mg/unit

blocks.zh: E&L 就像新買的水壺在不同條件下的滲出測試：把水壺用開水、咖啡、果汁各浸泡一週（這是 Extractables 的誇張條件），然後分析每種情況下有多少物質溶出。而 Leachables 是你每天正常用水壺喝水時，實際溶入飲用水中的量。你需要前者來了解最壞情況，但真正關心的是後者對健康的影響。
blocks.en: E&L is like a leaching test on a newly bought kettle under different conditions: soak the kettle in boiling water, coffee and fruit juice for a week each (these are the exaggerated conditions of extractables), then analyze how much substance leaches out in each case. Leachables, by contrast, are the amounts that actually enter your drinking water when you use the kettle normally every day. You need the former to understand the worst case, but what you really care about is the health impact of the latter.

blocks.zh: 矽酮管的特殊風險：原文特別提到，矽酮管中殘留的矽酮可顯著抑制過濾器的氣泡點測試 (Bubble Point)，導致假性完整性測試失敗。這說明 Leachables 的危害不只是毒性，也可能破壞關鍵製程控制測試的可信度——這是選擇 SUS 組件時需要特別注意的交互作用。
blocks.en: Special risk of silicone tubing: the source document specifically notes that residual silicone from silicone tubing can significantly suppress the bubble point test of filters, leading to false integrity test failures. This shows that the harm from leachables is not limited to toxicity; they can also undermine the reliability of critical process control tests. This is an interaction that requires special attention when selecting SUS components.

blocks.zh: 評估供應商 E&L 文件時的決策邏輯：
blocks.en: Decision logic when evaluating supplier E&L documentation:

blocks.zh: 低風險應用（短接觸時間、非直接產品接觸、上游製程）→ 供應商標準 E&L 文件通常足夠
blocks.en: Low-risk applications (short contact time, no direct product contact, upstream processing) → the supplier standard E&L documentation is usually sufficient

blocks.zh: 中風險應用（緩衝液接觸、儲存袋）→ 需確認供應商測試條件與你的製程條件的重疊性
blocks.en: Medium-risk applications (buffer contact, storage bags) → confirm the overlap between the supplier test conditions and your process conditions

blocks.zh: 高風險應用（直接最終產品接觸、長期儲存、高溫製程）→ 需要進行使用者層面的 Leachables 確認研究
blocks.en: High-risk applications (direct final product contact, long-term storage, high-temperature processes) → a user-level leachables confirmation study is required

blocks.zh: 你的製程使用 pH 8.0 的磷酸鹽緩衝液在 37°C 接觸 SUS 袋子長達 14 天。供應商的 E&L 研究是在 pH 4 和 pH 8，但溫度僅測試到 40°C，接觸時間僅到 8 天。你認為這份文件是否足夠支持你的應用？
blocks.en: Your process uses pH 8.0 phosphate buffer in contact with a SUS bag at 37°C for up to 14 days. The supplier E&L study was performed at pH 4 and pH 8, but only up to 40°C and only up to 8 days of contact time. Do you think this documentation is sufficient to support your application?

blocks.zh: 如果在你的 DS（原液）儲存袋的 Leachables 研究中發現 2,4-Di-tert-butylphenol（DTBP，一種常見抗氧化劑降解產物），你的下一步風險評估應該包括哪些要素？
blocks.en: If 2,4-Di-tert-butylphenol (DTBP, a common antioxidant degradation product) is found in the leachables study of your DS (drug substance) storage bag, what elements should your next risk assessment include?

blocks.zh: 8.9 Attribute 9: Chemical Compatibility（化學相容性）
blocks.en: 8.9 Attribute 9: Chemical Compatibility

blocks.zh: 核心概念：化學相容性的三維度評估
blocks.en: Key Concept: A Three-Dimensional Assessment of Chemical Compatibility

blocks.zh: 化學相容性 (Chemical Compatibility) 評估的是接觸材料在特定化學環境中的物理耐受性。評估必須考量三個維度的組合：
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility assesses the physical resistance of contact materials in a specific chemical environment. The assessment must consider the combination of three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 化學物質：酸、鹼、有機溶劑、清潔劑、重金屬離子
blocks.en: Chemicals: acids, bases, organic solvents, cleaning agents, heavy metal ions

blocks.zh: 溫度：熱塑性彈性體在高溫下相容性可能急劇下降
blocks.en: Temperature: the compatibility of thermoplastic elastomers can drop sharply at high temperature

blocks.zh: 壓力與濃度：高壓或高濃度可加速材料劣化
blocks.en: Pressure and concentration: high pressure or high concentration can accelerate material degradation

blocks.zh: 化學相容性就像選擇廚房手套材質——橡膠手套可以接觸稀釋的清潔劑，但如果用來接觸丙酮，它可能在幾分鐘內溶脹失效。而且同樣的手套在 20°C 還好，但泡在 80°C 的溶液裡可能立刻軟化變形。SUS 組件的化學相容性圖表就是你在「選手套」前必須查閱的參考資料。
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility is like choosing the material of kitchen gloves: rubber gloves can handle diluted detergent, but if used with acetone they may swell and fail within minutes. The same gloves that are fine at 20°C may soften and deform immediately in a solution at 80°C. The chemical compatibility chart for a SUS component is the reference you must consult before "choosing the gloves".

blocks.zh: 供應商的化學相容性圖表只涵蓋他們測試過的化學品。如果你的製程使用了圖表上沒有列出的化學品，或者你的操作溫度/壓力超出了測試範圍，必須自行進行相容性驗證——這不能省略，因為失敗的後果是組件在製程中降解，直接污染產品。
blocks.en: A supplier chemical compatibility chart covers only the chemicals they have tested. If your process uses chemicals not listed in the chart, or your operating temperature/pressure exceeds the tested range, you must perform your own compatibility verification. This cannot be skipped, because the consequence of failure is that the component degrades during processing and directly contaminates the product.

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 316L 不鏽鋼管件接頭在某些 SUS 系統中需要特別確認——不鏽鋼的金屬離子（鐵、鎳、鉻）溶出可能影響對金屬敏感的生物製品。
blocks.en: This is also why 316L stainless steel tubing fittings need special confirmation in some SUS systems: leaching of metal ions (iron, nickel, chromium) from stainless steel may affect metal-sensitive biological products.

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 組件選型時建立化學相容性評估矩陣：列出所有接觸化學品（含 CIP/SIP 清潔劑）×組件材質×操作溫度範圍，逐一核對供應商相容性圖表。不相容或未測試的組合需要補充 in-house 測試或改選材質。
blocks.en: When selecting SUS components, build a chemical compatibility assessment matrix: list all contact chemicals (including CIP/SIP cleaning agents) × component materials × operating temperature range, and check each one against the supplier compatibility chart. Incompatible or untested combinations require supplementary in-house testing or a change of material.

blocks.zh: 8.10 Attribute 10: Protein Adsorption Studies（蛋白質吸附研究）
blocks.en: 8.10 Attribute 10: Protein Adsorption Studies

blocks.zh: 核心概念：蛋白質吸附的機制與影響
blocks.en: Key Concept: Mechanisms and Impact of Protein Adsorption

blocks.zh: 蛋白質吸附 (Protein Adsorption) 是蛋白質分子與接觸表面之間的物理/化學交互作用，導致蛋白質從溶液中「消失」到表面上。對生物製藥製程的影響包括：
blocks.en: Protein adsorption is the physical/chemical interaction between protein molecules and a contact surface, causing the protein to "disappear" from solution onto the surface. Its impacts on biopharmaceutical processes include:

blocks.zh: 產品損失：珍貴的 mAb 或蛋白質治療藥物被吸附在袋壁、管件內壁上，導致有效劑量降低
blocks.en: Product loss: valuable mAb or therapeutic protein is adsorbed onto bag walls and the inner walls of tubing, lowering the effective dose

blocks.zh: 聚集 (Aggregation)：吸附-脫附循環可能誘導蛋白質構型變化，促進聚集體形成
blocks.en: Aggregation: adsorption-desorption cycles may induce conformational changes in the protein and promote the formation of aggregates

blocks.zh: 免疫原性：吸附後釋放的蛋白質可能具有不同的免疫原性特徵
blocks.en: Immunogenicity: protein released after adsorption may have a different immunogenicity profile

blocks.zh: 測試設計要求
blocks.en: Test Design Requirements

blocks.zh:
推薦模型蛋白：
  - 胰島素 (Insulin)：小分子，易於檢測
  - 肝素 (Heparin)：大分子，帶電荷

替代方案：
  - 牛免疫球蛋白 (bIgG)
  - 牛血清白蛋白 (BSA)
  - 定量胺基酸分析法測定

研究設計要點：
  ≥2 個儲存溫度點
  多個時間點（動力學數據）
  必須報告表面積：體積比（S/A:V）

對照組：
  不鏽鋼系統 + 玻璃系統（硼矽酸鹽玻璃）
  → 建立跨實驗室比較基準
blocks.en:
Recommended model proteins:
  - Insulin: small molecule, easy to detect
  - Heparin: large molecule, charged

Alternatives:
  - Bovine immunoglobulin (bIgG)
  - Bovine serum albumin (BSA)
  - Quantification by amino acid analysis

Key points of study design:
  ≥2 storage temperatures
  Multiple time points (kinetic data)
  The surface area to volume ratio (S/A:V) must be reported

Controls:
  Stainless steel system + glass system (borosilicate glass)
  → establishes a baseline for cross-laboratory comparison

blocks.zh: 蛋白質吸附就像烤箱裡的油脂沾黏——不同材質的烤盤（不沾塗層 vs 普通鋼）沾黏程度不同，溫度越高、接觸時間越長，沾黏越多。而且表面積大的烤盤（S/A:V 高）比小的沾黏總量更多。SUS 材料（如超低密度 PE）的表面特性在伽瑪輻射後可能改變，就像一個烤盤用過幾次後不沾塗層受損，沾黏性增加一樣。
blocks.en: Protein adsorption is like grease sticking in an oven: different pan materials (non-stick coating vs. plain steel) show different levels of sticking, and the higher the temperature and the longer the contact time, the more sticks. A pan with a large surface area (high S/A:V) also collects more in total than a small one. The surface properties of SUS materials (e.g., ultra-low-density PE) may change after gamma irradiation, just as the non-stick coating of a pan gets damaged after several uses and sticking increases.

blocks.zh: 目前沒有廣泛接受的標準方法，這代表此項屬性的評估更依賴科學判斷而非機械性合規。在設計研究時，必須論證所選模型蛋白與你的目標藥物在吸附行為上的相關性。高濃度蛋白質藥物（如 >100 mg/mL 的 mAb 製劑）對吸附的敏感性往往與低濃度完全不同，需要特別關注。
blocks.en: There is currently no widely accepted standard method, which means the assessment of this attribute relies more on scientific judgment than on mechanical compliance. When designing the study, you must justify that the chosen model protein is relevant to your target drug in terms of adsorption behavior. High-concentration protein drugs (e.g., mAb formulations at >100 mg/mL) are often sensitive to adsorption in a completely different way from low-concentration ones and need special attention.

blocks.zh: 8.11 Attribute 11: Endotoxin Testing（內毒素測試）
blocks.en: 8.11 Attribute 11: Endotoxin Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：內毒素 vs 熱原的關係
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Relationship Between Endotoxin and Pyrogen

blocks.zh: 內毒素 (Endotoxin) 是革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁的脂多糖 (LPS) 成分，是最主要的熱原物質。本指引明確指出，在 SUS 評估的語境下，內毒素與熱原視為等義詞。
blocks.en: Endotoxin is the lipopolysaccharide (LPS) component of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria and is the most important pyrogenic substance. The guide states explicitly that, in the context of SUS evaluation, endotoxin and pyrogen are treated as synonyms.

blocks.zh: LAL 測試（鱟試驗）是目前最靈敏且被藥典認可的內毒素檢測方法，靈敏度可達 0.005 EU/mL。
blocks.en: The LAL test (Limulus amebocyte lysate test) is currently the most sensitive pharmacopeia-recognized method for detecting endotoxin, with a sensitivity of down to 0.005 EU/mL.

blocks.zh: 內毒素的危害：即使在微量濃度（ng/kg 體重），靜脈注射到人體後也可引起嚴重的系統性炎症反應（SIRS），危及生命。
blocks.en: Hazard of endotoxin: even at trace concentrations (ng/kg body weight), intravenous administration can cause a severe systemic inflammatory response (SIRS) that is life-threatening.

blocks.zh: 測試與製程控制要求
blocks.en: Testing and Process Control Requirements

blocks.zh:
基本要求：
  測試標準：USP <85> / EP 2.6.14（LAL 法）
  測試樣品：與供貨狀態一致（含輻射狀態）
  一般驗收標準：≤ USP WFI 內毒素標準

供應商必須聲明的製程控制：
  1. 組件組裝環境：潔淨室等級 + 人員衣著控管
  2. 微粒目視檢查程序
  3. 定期測試頻率文件化

重要：
  不接受無頻率聲明的一次性測試報告
  需要持續監控數據，非僅確效數據
blocks.en:
Basic requirements:
  Test standard: USP <85> / EP 2.6.14 (LAL method)
  Test samples: consistent with the as-supplied state (including irradiation status)
  General acceptance criterion: ≤ USP WFI endotoxin limit

Process controls the supplier must declare:
  1. Component assembly environment: cleanroom grade + personnel gowning control
  2. Visual particulate inspection procedure
  3. Documented periodic testing frequency

Important:
  One-off test reports without a stated frequency are not accepted
  Ongoing monitoring data are required, not only validation data

blocks.zh: 內毒素就像食品製造中的沙門氏菌檢驗——你不能只在工廠設立之初做一次測試，然後就假設問題永遠不會出現。每批產品都需要檢測，而且生產環境（無菌環境 + 穿著規定）需要持續維持，才能控制內毒素污染的源頭（革蘭氏陰性菌）。SUS 組件的內毒素控制邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Endotoxin control is like Salmonella testing in food manufacturing: you cannot run a test once when the plant is set up and then assume the problem will never appear. Every batch needs to be tested, and the production environment (controlled environment + gowning rules) must be continuously maintained to control the source of endotoxin contamination (Gram-negative bacteria). The endotoxin control logic for SUS components is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 內毒素不會被一般的滅菌方法（如 25 kGy 伽瑪輻射）消除——輻射滅菌殺死細菌，但內毒素是細菌死後釋放的細胞壁碎片，需要 250°C 乾熱或特殊去熱原處理才能降解。因此，組件的組裝環境和水質控制才是內毒素管控的關鍵，而非終末輻射滅菌。
blocks.en: Endotoxin is not eliminated by common sterilization methods (e.g., 25 kGy gamma irradiation): irradiation kills bacteria, but endotoxin consists of cell wall fragments released after the bacteria die, and it can only be degraded by dry heat at 250°C or a dedicated depyrogenation treatment. The assembly environment and water quality control of the components are therefore the key to endotoxin control, not terminal irradiation sterilization.

blocks.zh: 8.12 Attribute 12: Sterilization (Irradiation)（滅菌——輻射）
blocks.en: 8.12 Attribute 12: Sterilization (Irradiation)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SAL 與輻射劑量設定
blocks.en: Key Concept: SAL and Irradiation Dose Setting

blocks.zh: 無菌保證水準 (SAL, Sterility Assurance Level) 是量化描述滅菌效果的指標。醫療器材和藥品接觸組件通常要求 SAL = 10⁻⁶（每百萬件產品中最多 1 件可能含有存活微生物）。
blocks.en: Sterility assurance level (SAL) is the indicator that quantitatively describes sterilization effectiveness. Medical devices and drug-contact components generally require SAL = 10⁻⁶ (no more than 1 in a million units may contain a surviving microorganism).

blocks.zh: 伽瑪輻射滅菌劑量設定方法（ISO 11137）：
blocks.en: Gamma sterilization dose setting methods (ISO 11137):

blocks.zh: Method 1：基於實測微生物抵抗性數據的完整統計方法
blocks.en: Method 1: a full statistical method based on measured microbial resistance data

blocks.zh: VDmax25：簡化的驗證方法，適用於低生物負荷（bioburden）的組件，確認 25 kGy 可達到 SAL 10⁻⁶
blocks.en: VDmax25: a simplified substantiation method for components with low bioburden, confirming that 25 kGy achieves SAL 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: 無菌貨架壽命驗證要素
blocks.en: Elements of Sterile Shelf-Life Validation

blocks.zh:
ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11607-1 框架：

無菌屏障系統 (Sterile Barrier System)：
  → 防止微生物進入的最小包裝
  → 確效：微生物屏障測試 + 密封強度

保護性包裝 (Protective Packaging)：
  → 保護無菌屏障系統的外層
  → 確效：運輸完整性測試

老化測試（二擇一或並行）：
  實時老化 (Real-time aging)：最直接，但耗時
  加速老化 (Accelerated aging)：依 ASTM F1980
  → 溫度係數 Q10 = 2（溫度每升10°C，反應速率倍增）

密封完整性測試方法：
  壓力衰減、染料滲透、氦氣洩漏、拉伸強度
blocks.en:
ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11607-1 framework:

Sterile barrier system:
  → the minimum package that prevents microbial ingress
  → validation: microbial barrier test + seal strength

Protective packaging:
  → the outer layer that protects the sterile barrier system
  → validation: transport integrity testing

Aging tests (either one or both in parallel):
  Real-time aging: most direct, but time-consuming
  Accelerated aging: per ASTM F1980
  → temperature coefficient Q10 = 2 (reaction rate doubles for every 10°C rise)

Seal integrity test methods:
  Pressure decay, dye penetration, helium leak, tensile strength

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌確效就像食品的保質期測試——你不只需要確認食品現在是安全的（剛生產時），還需要確認在標示的保質期結束時（比如 2 年後）仍然安全（無菌）。Product Family Matrixing 就像食品業的「代表性產品」概念——你不需要對每一種口味的餅乾都做完整測試，只需要選最難滅菌的代表性產品做完整確效，其他同系列的可以矩陣化覆蓋。
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization validation is like shelf-life testing of food: you need to confirm not only that the food is safe now (when just produced), but also that it is still safe (sterile) at the end of its labeled shelf life (say, 2 years later). Product family matrixing is like the "representative product" concept in the food industry: you do not need to run a full test on every flavor of cookie, only to select the most difficult-to-sterilize representative for full validation, and the others in the same family can be covered by a matrix approach.

blocks.zh: Bacteriostasis/Fungistasis 測試（抑菌/抑真菌測試，USP <71>）是確認滅菌測試本身有效性的前提——如果 SUS 組件的材料會抑制培養基中微生物的生長，那麼「無生長」的結果就不能作為無菌的證明。這是 USP <71> 的程序適用性測試，必須在驗證劑量實驗之前完成。
blocks.en: Bacteriostasis/fungistasis testing (USP <71>) is a prerequisite for confirming the validity of the sterility test itself: if the material of a SUS component inhibits microbial growth in the culture medium, a "no growth" result cannot be used as proof of sterility. This is the method suitability test of USP <71> and must be completed before the verification dose experiment.

blocks.zh: 你的供應商使用 VDmax25 方法確效。他們後來在工廠增加了一個新的組件組裝車間，組裝環境的潔淨度稍低，可能導致 pre-sterilization bioburden 增加。這個變更是否需要重新驗證輻射劑量？
blocks.en: Your supplier validated using the VDmax25 method. They later added a new component assembly room to the plant, where the cleanliness of the assembly environment is somewhat lower, which may increase the pre-sterilization bioburden. Does this change require the irradiation dose to be re-substantiated?

blocks.zh: 加速老化測試中，40°C 儲存 12 週被宣稱等效於 25°C 儲存 2 年。請解釋這個計算背後的假設，以及在什麼情況下這個假設可能不成立？
blocks.en: In accelerated aging testing, storage at 40°C for 12 weeks is claimed to be equivalent to storage at 25°C for 2 years. Explain the assumptions behind this calculation and the circumstances in which these assumptions may not hold.

blocks.zh: 8.13 Attribute 13: Container Closure Integrity（容器密封完整性）
blocks.en: 8.13 Attribute 13: Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CCI 的目的與測試選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concept: Purpose of CCI and the Logic of Test Selection

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性 (CCI, Container Closure Integrity) 確效的核心目的是證明密封系統能抵抗微生物進入——即維持無菌性。不同 CCI 測試方法對不同類型的洩漏和容器設計有不同適用性：
blocks.en: The core purpose of container closure integrity (CCI) validation is to demonstrate that the closure system can resist microbial ingress, that is, maintain sterility. Different CCI test methods are suited to different types of leaks and container designs:

blocks.zh: 確定性方法（Deterministic）：氦氣洩漏、真空衰減、壓力保持——基於物理測量，靈敏度高，不需要染料或微生物
blocks.en: Deterministic methods: helium leak, vacuum decay, pressure hold; based on physical measurement, highly sensitive, and requiring no dyes or microorganisms

blocks.zh: 機率性方法（Probabilistic）：染料滲透、微生物挑戰——依賴化學/生物指示劑，統計性質
blocks.en: Probabilistic methods: dye ingress, microbial challenge; they rely on chemical/biological indicators and are statistical in nature

blocks.zh: 行業趨勢正在從機率性方法轉向確定性方法（FDA 2016 指引偏好）。
blocks.en: The industry trend is moving from probabilistic to deterministic methods (the FDA 2016 guidance prefers them).

blocks.zh: CCI 測試方法選擇指引
blocks.en: CCI Test Method Selection Guide

blocks.zh:
剛性容器（瓶、卡匣）：
  → 真空衰減（ASTM F2338）
  → 氦氣質譜洩漏測試
  → 殘餘密封力（僅適用於瓶塞/瓶組合）

彈性容器（SUS 袋子）：
  → 壓力保持測試
  → 染料滲透（確效用）
  → 拉伸測試（密封強度）

軟管連接：
  → 壓縮測試（袋子封口）
  → 拉伸測試（接頭連接強度）

高靈敏度需求：
  → 氦氣洩漏（最低可偵測 ~10⁻⁹ cc He/s）
blocks.en:
Rigid containers (vials, cartridges):
  → Vacuum decay (ASTM F2338)
  → Helium mass spectrometry leak test
  → Residual seal force (applicable only to stopper/vial combinations)

Flexible containers (SUS bags):
  → Pressure hold test
  → Dye ingress (for validation)
  → Tensile test (seal strength)

Tubing connections:
  → Compression test (bag closure)
  → Tensile test (connector joint strength)

High-sensitivity needs:
  → Helium leak (lowest detectable ~10⁻⁹ cc He/s)

blocks.zh: CCI 測試就像汽車輪胎的氣密測試——你可以用肥皂水看有沒有氣泡（相當於染料法，機率性），也可以用精密儀器測量氣壓衰減速率（相當於真空衰減法，確定性）。對於無菌製品，我們需要的不只是「現在沒洩漏」，而是「在整個貨架壽命期間都不會讓細菌進入」，這就需要更嚴格的確定性方法。
blocks.en: CCI testing is like an airtightness test of a car tire: you can use soapy water to see whether bubbles form (equivalent to the dye method, probabilistic), or use a precision instrument to measure the rate of pressure decay (equivalent to vacuum decay, deterministic). For sterile products, what we need is not only "no leak now" but "no bacterial ingress throughout the whole shelf life", which calls for the more rigorous deterministic methods.

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 是容器密封完整性測試的重要參考章節，涵蓋確定性和機率性方法的分類與選擇邏輯。殘餘密封力 (Residual Seal Force) 是玻璃瓶/橡膠塞系統特有的要求，對 SUS 袋子不適用，但對使用 SUS 配件連接瓶塞的終端製品可能相關。
blocks.en: USP <1207> is an important reference chapter for container closure integrity testing, covering the classification and selection logic of deterministic and probabilistic methods. Residual seal force is a requirement specific to glass vial/rubber stopper systems; it does not apply to SUS bags, but may be relevant to finished products that use SUS fittings to connect to stoppers and vials.

blocks.zh: 你使用的 SUS 製程袋容積為 50L，批次量為 200 個袋子。你的 CCI 測試計畫應該使用多少個樣品來代表這個批次？USP <1207> 對此有何建議？
blocks.en: The SUS process bag you use has a volume of 50 L and the batch size is 200 bags. How many samples should your CCI test plan use to represent this batch? What does USP <1207> recommend in this regard?

blocks.zh: 你的 SUS 袋子通過了染料滲透 CCI 測試，但在微生物挑戰測試中發現 1 個袋子有微生物侵入。你如何解釋這兩個結果之間的差異？這說明染料滲透測試有什麼局限性？
blocks.en: Your SUS bags passed the dye ingress CCI test, but in the microbial challenge test 1 bag showed microbial ingress. How do you explain the difference between these two results? What does it say about the limitations of the dye ingress test?

blocks.zh: 8.14 Attribute 14: Particulate Testing（微粒測試）
blocks.en: 8.14 Attribute 14: Particulate Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUS 微粒的三個來源與分類
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Sources and Classes of SUS Particulates

blocks.zh: 微粒測試 (Particulate Testing) 針對的是可能從 SUS 組件材料中脫落進入產品的粒子。微粒依大小分為：
blocks.en: Particulate testing targets particles that may be shed from SUS component materials into the product. Particulates are classified by size:

blocks.zh: 可見微粒（>100 µm）：目視可見，直接違規
blocks.en: Visible particulates (>100 µm): visible to the naked eye and an immediate non-compliance

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒（1-100 µm）：光遮蔽法 (Light Obscuration) 偵測，USP <788> 主要對象
blocks.en: Subvisible particulates (1-100 µm): detected by light obscuration, the main target of USP <788>

blocks.zh: 次微米微粒（<1 µm）：納米粒子範疇，需要特殊技術（NTA, DLS等），目前尚無廣泛藥典規定
blocks.en: Submicron particulates (<1 µm): in the nanoparticle range, requiring special techniques (NTA, DLS, etc.); there are currently no widely applied pharmacopeial requirements

blocks.zh: 藥典微粒限度 Pharmacopeial Limits
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial Limits

blocks.zh:
USP <788> 注射用製品（大容量注射劑，LVP）：
  ≥10 µm：≤25 顆/mL
  ≥25 µm：≤3 顆/mL

EP 2.9.19 注射用製品（同 USP <788>）：
  ≥10 µm：≤25 顆/mL
  ≥25 µm：≤3 顆/mL

EP 2.9.20（用於眼用製劑）：
  ≥10 µm：≤50 顆/mL

注意：SUS 組件的沖洗液測試需滿足上述限度
實際數據（顆數/mL）必須報告，不接受僅寫「Pass」
blocks.en:
USP <788> injectable products (large-volume injections, LVP):
  ≥10 µm: ≤25 particles/mL
  ≥25 µm: ≤3 particles/mL

EP 2.9.19 injectable products (same as USP <788>):
  ≥10 µm: ≤25 particles/mL
  ≥25 µm: ≤3 particles/mL

EP 2.9.20 (for ophthalmic preparations):
  ≥10 µm: ≤50 particles/mL

Note: rinse solution testing of SUS components must meet the limits above
Actual data (particles/mL) must be reported; "Pass" alone is not accepted

blocks.zh: SUS 微粒脫落就像新衣服的掉色問題——你不能只確認新衣服在架上沒有染料，還需要模擬實際使用條件（洗滌、磨擦）來評估染料會不會轉移到其他衣物上。同樣地，SUS 袋子在靜置狀態下可能微粒很少，但在實際使用中（攪拌、蠕動泵操作、溫度循環）可能因機械應力而脫落更多微粒。
blocks.en: SUS particulate shedding is like color bleeding from new clothes: you cannot simply confirm there is no dye on a new garment on the shelf; you also need to simulate actual use conditions (washing, rubbing) to assess whether the dye transfers to other clothing. Similarly, a SUS bag may show few particulates at rest, but in actual use (mixing, peristaltic pump operation, temperature cycling) it may shed more particulates due to mechanical stress.

blocks.zh: 「以藥典限度作為起點」（as a starting point）意味著藥典限度只是最低要求。對於直接在 SUS 中完成最終充填的應用（無後續過濾步驟），微粒標準可能需要比藥典更嚴格。另外，如果在微粒測試中發現粒子，必須進行成分鑑定（如 SEM-EDX 或 FTIR）來確認是否為 SUS 材料的脫落——這對根本原因分析至關重要。
blocks.en: "Using the pharmacopeial limits as a starting point" means that the pharmacopeial limits are only the minimum requirement. For applications where final filling is done directly in the SUS (with no subsequent filtration step), the particulate criteria may need to be stricter than the pharmacopeia. In addition, if particles are found in particulate testing, they must be identified (e.g., by SEM-EDX or FTIR) to confirm whether they are shed from the SUS material; this is critical for root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: 在評估新 SUS 袋子時，除了靜態微粒測試，還應考慮動態微粒測試：模擬實際製程條件（攪拌 RPM、持續時間、溫度），然後測試袋子中液體的微粒計數。這比靜態沖洗測試更能反映真實使用風險，特別是對於長時間攪拌培養的生物反應袋。
blocks.en: When evaluating a new SUS bag, in addition to static particulate testing, dynamic particulate testing should also be considered: simulate actual process conditions (mixing RPM, duration, temperature) and then measure the particle count of the liquid in the bag. This better reflects real use risk than a static rinse test, especially for bioreactor bags used in long-duration agitated cultures.

blocks.zh: 8.15 Attribute 15: Calibration of Embedded Instrumentation（嵌入式儀器校正）
blocks.en: 8.15 Attribute 15: Calibration of Embedded Instrumentation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：嵌入式 SUS 儀器的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Key Concept: Special Challenges of Embedded SUS Instrumentation

blocks.zh: 現代 SUS 組件越來越多地整合了嵌入式感測器，例如：
blocks.en: Modern SUS components increasingly integrate embedded sensors, such as:

blocks.zh: 一次性 pH 感測器（集成在袋子或管線中）
blocks.en: Single-use pH sensors (integrated in the bag or line)

blocks.zh: 溶氧 (DO) 感測器（生物反應器袋）
blocks.en: Dissolved oxygen (DO) sensors (bioreactor bags)

blocks.zh: 壓力/溫度傳感器
blocks.en: Pressure/temperature sensors

blocks.zh: 濁度計（用於細胞培養監控）
blocks.en: Turbidity sensors (for cell culture monitoring)

blocks.zh: 這些感測器的挑戰在於：它們與袋子一起被輻射滅菌，使用後隨袋子丟棄（單次使用）——傳統「使用前/使用後校正」的儀器管理框架需要重新思考。
blocks.en: The challenge with these sensors is that they are irradiation-sterilized together with the bag and discarded with it after use (single use), so the traditional instrument management framework of "pre-use/post-use calibration" needs to be rethought.

blocks.zh: 嵌入式儀器文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements for Embedded Instruments

blocks.zh:
必要文件清單：
  1. 可追溯校正證書
     → 符合 NIST 或 UKAS 標準
     → 包含校正有效期限

  2. 使用前/使用後獨立校正驗證方法
     → 例如：使用已知 pH 標準溶液的 1-point 驗證

  3. 校正程序詳細說明
     → 校正範圍（如 pH 2-12）
     → 迴路容差（Loop Tolerance）

  4. 貨架壽命數據
     → 儲存條件對感測器精度的影響
     → 是否允許/禁止重複使用

  5. 耐受性數據
     → 輻射滅菌（通常 25-40 kGy）
     → 清潔/消毒耐受性
blocks.en:
Required documentation list:
  1. Traceable calibration certificate
     → conforming to NIST or UKAS standards
     → includes the calibration expiry date

  2. Pre-use/post-use independent calibration verification method
     → e.g., a 1-point verification using a known pH standard solution

  3. Detailed calibration procedure
     → calibration range (e.g., pH 2-12)
     → loop tolerance

  4. Shelf-life data
     → effect of storage conditions on sensor accuracy
     → whether reuse is permitted or prohibited

  5. Resistance data
     → irradiation sterilization (typically 25-40 kGy)
     → resistance to cleaning/disinfection

blocks.zh: 嵌入式 SUS 感測器就像一次性血糖試紙——試紙本身已經過出廠校正，你每次使用前用標準液做一個快速驗證，使用後直接丟棄，不需要送回工廠重新校正。但你需要確保：試紙在有效期內（貨架壽命）、儲存條件正確、且原廠提供了可追溯的批次校正數據。如果試紙受潮（相當於感測器在不合適的條件下儲存），即使在有效期內也可能讀值偏差。
blocks.en: An embedded SUS sensor is like a disposable blood glucose test strip: the strip itself has been calibrated at the factory, you run a quick verification with a standard solution before each use, and you discard it afterwards without sending it back to the factory for recalibration. But you need to make sure that the strip is within its expiry date (shelf life), stored correctly, and that the manufacturer has provided traceable batch calibration data. If the strip gets damp (equivalent to a sensor stored under unsuitable conditions), the reading may be biased even within the expiry date.

blocks.zh: NIST（美國）和 UKAS（英國）是最受廣泛認可的計量標準機構，校正溯源性 (Calibration Traceability) 需回溯到這些國家標準。對於 GMP 環境，校正有效期到期的嵌入式感測器不得使用，即使實體上仍然完好。在 PAT（製程分析技術）應用中，嵌入式感測器的校正狀態直接影響製程可接受性，是 FDA/EMA 法規稽核的高度關注項目。
blocks.en: NIST (US) and UKAS (UK) are the most widely recognized metrology standards bodies, and calibration traceability must be linked back to these national standards. In a GMP environment, an embedded sensor whose calibration has expired must not be used, even if it is physically intact. In PAT (process analytical technology) applications, the calibration status of embedded sensors directly affects process acceptability and is a high-focus item in FDA/EMA regulatory audits.

blocks.zh: 在引入含嵌入式感測器的 SUS 組件時，需要建立以下 SOP 框架：
blocks.en: When introducing SUS components containing embedded sensors, the following SOP framework needs to be established:

blocks.zh: 進廠校正驗證程序（與現有校正管理系統整合）
blocks.en: Incoming calibration verification procedure (integrated with the existing calibration management system)

blocks.zh: 校正數據的電子化記錄（包含批號、校正日期、有效期）
blocks.en: Electronic recording of calibration data (including lot number, calibration date, expiry date)

blocks.zh: 失效處理程序（校正到期、讀值異常的處置路徑）
blocks.en: Failure handling procedure (disposition path for expired calibration or abnormal readings)

blocks.zh: 與 DCS/SCADA 系統的連接驗證（IQ/OQ 文件）
blocks.en: Connection verification with DCS/SCADA systems (IQ/OQ documentation)

blocks.zh: 廢棄管理（部分感測器含特殊材料需特殊廢棄處理）
blocks.en: Waste management (some sensors contain special materials that require special disposal)

blocks.zh: 你的 SUS 生物反應袋內建了一個溶氧感測器，但供應商只提供了批次層級的出廠校正數據，沒有單支感測器的個別校正證書。這是否符合 GMP 要求？你應該要求供應商提供什麼？
blocks.en: Your SUS bioreactor bag has a built-in dissolved oxygen sensor, but the supplier provides only lot-level factory calibration data and no individual calibration certificate for each sensor. Does this meet GMP requirements? What should you ask the supplier to provide?

blocks.zh: 你發現你工廠庫存中有一批已過校正有效期的 SUS pH 感測器袋，但這批袋子在物理外觀上完好無損。你的 QA 決策是什麼？有沒有任何可以「延期」的彈性做法？
blocks.en: You find a lot of SUS pH sensor bags in your plant inventory whose calibration validity has expired, although the bags look physically intact. What is your QA decision? Is there any flexible way to "extend" the validity?

blocks.zh: 附錄4 重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Appendix 4 Section Summary

blocks.zh: 生物相容性 (Attr.1)：USP <87>/<88> 或 ISO 10993-1，需提供實際評分（非僅寫 Pass）；Class VI 塑膠 70°C 萃取；供應商須 GLP 認可實驗室出具完整報告。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility (Attr.1): USP <87>/<88> or ISO 10993-1, with actual scores required (not just "Pass"); Class VI plastics with extraction at 70°C; the supplier must provide a complete report from a GLP-accredited laboratory.

blocks.zh: 機械性能 & 氣體穿透 (Attr.2-3)：按 ASTM F2097、BPSA 矩陣提供文件化測試結果；氣體穿透數據（OTR、WVTR）必須附完整測試條件（膜厚、溫度、壓力、RH），偏離 ASTM 方法須明確說明差異。
blocks.en: Mechanical properties & gas transmission (Attr.2-3): documented test results per ASTM F2097 and the BPSA matrix; gas transmission data (OTR, WVTR) must include full test conditions (film thickness, temperature, pressure, RH), and any deviation from the ASTM method must be clearly explained.

blocks.zh: 藥典理化測試 (Attr.4)：按聚合物類型選擇 USP <661> 或 EP 3.1.x 系列，不同聚合物的測試矩陣不同（見 Table 8.1）；IR 光譜確認材料身份，防止材料代換。
blocks.en: Compendial physicochemical testing (Attr.4): select USP <661> or the EP 3.1.x series by polymer type; the test matrix differs between polymers (see Table 8.1); IR spectroscopy confirms material identity and prevents material substitution.

blocks.zh: 動物來源管控 (Attr.5)：TSE/BSE 風險控制是核心，凡含動物來源成分（包括潤滑劑、清潔劑）須提供 EDQM CEP 文件；需評估地理 BSE 風險等級及感染性組織類別。
blocks.en: Animal origin control (Attr.5): TSE/BSE risk control is the core; any component of animal origin (including lubricants and cleaning agents) requires an EDQM CEP document; the geographical BSE risk category and the infectivity tissue category must be assessed.

blocks.zh: TOC、pH、導電度 (Attr.6-7)：三者均為非專一性一致性指標，主要功能是確效期間建立基準值，後續進廠監控時作為觸發調查的篩選指標；測試樣品狀態須與供貨狀態一致。
blocks.en: TOC, pH, conductivity (Attr.6-7): all three are non-specific consistency indicators whose main function is to establish baseline values during validation and then serve as screening indicators for triggering investigations in later incoming monitoring; the test sample state must match the as-supplied state.

blocks.zh: E&L (Attr.8)：設計空間導向方法（非 USP <381>/<661> 傳統路徑）；極性/非極性溶劑、低高 pH、不同溫度、不同接觸時間的組合研究；GC-MS + HPLC-MS + ICP-MS 三方法組合為最低要求；超過 ICH Q3C Class 1 限度的物質須識別；矽酮殘留可抑制過濾器氣泡點。
blocks.en: E&L (Attr.8): a design space-oriented approach (not the traditional USP <381>/<661> route); combined studies of polar/non-polar solvents, low and high pH, different temperatures and different contact times; the combination of GC-MS + HPLC-MS + ICP-MS is the minimum requirement; substances exceeding the ICH Q3C Class 1 limits must be identified; silicone residues can suppress filter bubble point.

blocks.zh: 化學相容性 & 蛋白質吸附 (Attr.9-10)：化學相容性須涵蓋化學品 × 溫度 × 壓力三維度；圖表範圍外的接觸條件需自行評估。蛋白質吸附研究目前無標準方法，需多溫度點 + 多時間點 + 報告 S/A:V 比；與不鏽鋼/玻璃系統並行比較建立基準。
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility & protein adsorption (Attr.9-10): chemical compatibility must cover the three dimensions of chemicals × temperature × pressure; contact conditions outside the chart range must be evaluated by the user. There is currently no standard method for protein adsorption studies; they need multiple temperatures + multiple time points + a reported S/A:V ratio, with side-by-side comparison against stainless steel/glass systems to establish a baseline.

blocks.zh: 內毒素 (Attr.11)：LAL 法 (USP <85>/EP 2.6.14)；組裝環境控制比終末滅菌更關鍵（輻射不消除內毒素）；需定期測試並文件化頻率。
blocks.en: Endotoxin (Attr.11): LAL method (USP <85>/EP 2.6.14); control of the assembly environment is more critical than terminal sterilization (irradiation does not eliminate endotoxin); periodic testing with a documented frequency is required.

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌確效 (Attr.12)：依 ISO 11137；包含劑量設定方法（Method 1 或 VDmax25）、生物負荷測定、Product Family 矩陣化設計、Bacteriostasis/Fungistasis 測試、貨架壽命確效（實時 + 加速老化）。
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization validation (Attr.12): per ISO 11137; includes dose setting method (Method 1 or VDmax25), bioburden determination, product family matrix design, bacteriostasis/fungistasis testing, and shelf-life validation (real-time + accelerated aging).

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性 (Attr.13)：至少使用一種 CCI 測試方法確效；確定性方法（氦氣洩漏、真空衰減）優於機率性方法（染料滲透）；依容器類型選擇適當方法；參考 USP <1207>。
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (Attr.13): validate with at least one CCI test method; deterministic methods (helium leak, vacuum decay) are preferred over probabilistic methods (dye ingress); select the appropriate method by container type; refer to USP <1207>.

blocks.zh: 微粒測試 (Attr.14)：USP <788>/EP 2.9.19 為起點；需報告實際數據（顆/mL），不接受僅寫 Pass；測試樣品須與供貨狀態一致；直接充填應用需考慮更嚴格標準。
blocks.en: Particulate testing (Attr.14): USP <788>/EP 2.9.19 as a starting point; actual data (particles/mL) must be reported and "Pass" alone is not accepted; test samples must match the as-supplied state; direct-fill applications need to consider stricter criteria.

blocks.zh: 嵌入式儀器校正 (Attr.15)：需可追溯至 NIST/UKAS 的校正證書 + 有效期限；驗證使用前/後獨立校正能力；提供輻射/清潔耐受性數據；連接至終端用戶控制系統的技術驗證文件。
blocks.en: Calibration of embedded instrumentation (Attr.15): a calibration certificate traceable to NIST/UKAS + expiry date; the ability to verify pre-use/post-use independent calibration; irradiation/cleaning resistance data; technical verification documentation for the connection to the end-user control system.
